annotation.summary_en: Zambian Ministry of Technology and Science news item reporting the November 2024 launch of the national AI Strategy. Minister Mutati presents AI as a driver of wealth, jobs and public service delivery, built on five building blocks including connectivity, data, trust and cybersecurity, innovation and partnerships. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Zambia launched its national AI Strategy in Lusaka in November 2024.
Strategy rests on five building blocks: connectivity, reliable data, trust and confidence, innovation/entrepreneurship, partnerships.
AI expected to enhance public service delivery, education, health and agriculture.
Developed with partners including Finland and the Tony Blair Foundation.
Zambia is among few African countries with an AI strategy.
